tests.title: Guest places a bank transfer order with home delivery
tests.goal: A guest can buy a non-quota product with home delivery and Bank Transfer, and the CRM order matches.
preconditions: Logged out; promo popup and notification prompt dismissed
A non-quota product (quota products need a member, BUG-005)

steps.text: Add the product to the cart and open /checkout
Shipping Method 住宅送貨, recipient, phone, address, delivery date, time slot and every other Delivery Info field
Payment Bank Transfer, tick 結帳前同意, Proceed to checkout
Open the order in the CRM

expected.text: Missing delivery info is refused with a message
Thank-you page /checkout/thank-you?txn_key=TXN... with the order number and UPLOAD PAYMENT PROVE
CRM order: Pending Payment, Bank Transfer, total, recipient, address and delivery info as entered

checks.label: Missing delivery info is refused with a message
Thank-you page /checkout/thank-you?txn_key=TXN... with the order number and UPLOAD PAYMENT PROVE
CRM order: Pending Payment, Bank Transfer, total, recipient, address and delivery info as entered

notes: TXN0126102700006, NAKAJIMA cake HKD 0.10, 住宅送貨, shipping 0.00, Bank Transfer. Missing 回收聖誕樹日期 refused with a message.

tests.title: Guest tracks an order by order number and email
tests.goal: Order Tracking shows a guest order only to someone who knows its email, and reflects later status changes.
data: Order number and email of that order; a different email; another order number

steps.text: Footer > Order Tracking (/guest-order-tracking): order number + correct email
Same order with upper-case email and lower-case order number
Cancel the order in the CRM, track it again

expected.text: Correct pair shows the order (date, payment, total, status, details, delivery info)
Wrong email and other order: "The related order does not exist." with no order data
After cancellation the status shows CANCELED

checks.label: Correct pair shows the order (date, payment, total, status, details, delivery info)
Wrong email and other order: "The related order does not exist." with no order data
After cancellation the status shows CANCELED

notes: All combinations behave; CANCELED shown after CRM void.
